caption: The video showcases a cream-colored looped-pile rug laid flat on a white, water-slicked washing surface, with soapy foam pooling along the right side and foreground. A long-handled scrub brush, its black shaft entering from above and its gray-and-blue head bristled in dark fibers, is already working the pile as the clip opens. The brush head, blurred by motion, sweeps from the center toward the far-right edge, where it lingers and agitates the fibers. It then travels back leftward across the rug, again trailing blur, and slides out of frame at the left edge. For several moments only the wet rug and foam remain visible, until a small corner of the brush reappears at the left margin. The white brick wall, a blue machine, and a ladder stay fixed in the background.
relations: The scrub brush sweeping rightward produces motion blur and agitates the soapy foam along the rug.
As the brush travels leftward and exits the frame, only the wet rug and foam remain visible.
The brush reappears at the left margin after a brief absence, while background elements remain fixed.
